description: Defense-in-depth file upload pipeline for ASP.NET Core 10+. An 8-layer validation and encrypted-storage pipeline lifted from a production document-intake workflow: size + batch limits, extension allowlist, MIME / extension cross-check, magic-byte signatures, filename inspection, deep structural content validation (JPEG / PNG / WebP walkers + PDF pattern scan with FlateDecode-compressed stream inspection), pluggable virus scanning (Windows Defender or ClamAV), and AES-256-GCM envelope encryption with a per-file random DEK wrapped under an Argon2id-derived master KEK (RFC 9106 / OWASP 2024+). Includes a hardened reference download controller, image recompression to strip polyglot tails, secret-misconfiguration startup guards, and a SharpFuzz / AFL++ harness for the deep content validator. Honest limitations documented in KNOWN-GAPS.md; every security claim traces to source in SECURITY-ANALYSIS.md.
releaseNotes:
v2.0.0 — first stable release of the modernized line.

BREAKING CHANGES vs. 1.0.0:
  • Target framework moved from net8.0 to net10.0 only. Consumers on net8.0
    must either upgrade their runtime or pin to 1.0.0 (the prior stable).
  • Master Key Encryption Key (KEK) derivation defaults to Argon2id (RFC 9106;
    m=64 MiB, t=3, p=4) instead of PBKDF2-SHA256. Files written by 1.0.0 still
    decrypt automatically when FileUpload:KeyDerivation:LegacyKekFallback=true
    (the default) — no migration step required. New writes use the Argon2id KEK.
  • New required configuration namespace FileUpload:KeyDerivation:* with sensible
    defaults. Pre-existing FileUpload:* keys are unchanged.

Highlights:
  • Memory-hard Argon2id KEK derivation (OWASP 2024+ recommendation). Memory-
    hardness raises GPU/ASIC brute-force cost-per-guess by orders of magnitude
    over the prior PBKDF2-SHA256 derivation.
  • Configurable KDF: Argon2id (default) or Pbkdf2 (FIPS-restricted environments).
    Argon2id parameters and PBKDF2 iteration count tunable from appsettings.json.
  • Online-safe upgrade: PBKDF2-derived legacy KEKs (600 000 and 210 000 iterations)
    are tried during decryption only. No file on disk is bricked by the upgrade.
  • Packaging: deterministic build, Source Link, snupkg symbols, README + LICENSE
    + SECURITY-ANALYSIS + KNOWN-GAPS bundled inside the package.
  • Documentation: full code-traced Implementation & Crypto Posture table,
    honest residual-risk list, and FIPS-posture statement in README and
    SECURITY-ANALYSIS.md.

The 8-layer upload pipeline itself is unchanged — the validation, scanning,
and on-disk envelope format are byte-for-byte identical to preview.2 and
preview.3, which were the candidates for this release.
title: SecureFileUpload.Core — defense-in-depth file upload for ASP.NET Core 10+
